result.scope: Actual frozen FIFO pool, synthetic session factory, controlled scheduling delay on head Event.wait after signal. Four-slot pool/two queued borrowers/two released slots. Does not measure natural stall frequency or database performance.

decision: Controlled head scheduling stall blocks later borrowers even with two idle slots. Prototype assigning available reservations FIFO under the condition, then waking each assigned owner to probe/create outside lock. Preserve reservation order, exact live/retiring/long-call charges, deadline and closed-state refusal, and cleanup of granted-but-not-yet-consumed tickets. No bypass of older tickets.
limitations: Synthetic sessions and deliberate100ms delay, one deterministic scenario. No natural stall frequency, throughput comparison or database speed claim. Existing FIFO semantics explain baseline behavior; candidate must retain FIFO allocation while decoupling scheduling.
